title: The first video on YouTube is about elephants’ trunks.
description:
The first video on YouTube is about elephants’ trunks. Jawed Karim uploaded Me at the zoo on 23 April 2005, at 8:31 pm Pacific time.

YouTube co-founder who appears in the clip, filmed at the San Diego Zoo.

The length of the video. Sources vary by about a second.

A school friend, Yakov Lapitsky, filmed it. Wikipedia describes him as Karim’s high school friend.

The cool thing, he says, is that elephants have really, really, really long trunks. That is the whole point of the video, and the reason it is the most famous upload on the site.

The San Diego Zoo left a pinned comment in 2020. Wikipedia reports it became the most liked comment on the platform, with 4.7 million likes.

More than 416 million views, as of September 2026, for 19 seconds of elephants.

Sources:
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo - Wikipedia; established the upload by co-founder Jawed Karim on 23 April 2005 at 8:31:52 pm PDT, a length of about 19 seconds, the San Diego Zoo setting, Yakov Lapitsky (a school friend) filming, the quoted line about really, really, really long trunks, more than 416 million views as of September 2026, and the San Diego Zoo pinned comment of 2020 with 4.7 million likes.
